purpose: Hong Kong character forms for the Hong Kong derivation (docs/ZH_HANT_HK_TW_PLAN_20261118.md H2): Taiwan form -> Hong Kong form, applied to every Hong Kong string after the regional terms. Picked from OpenCC tw2t+t2hk over the Traditional corpus (2026-11-18, counts are Taiwan-text occurrences then).

left_out.群→羣: Hong Kong writes 群 in practice
left_out.參→蔘: only ginseng; OpenCC maps every 參
left_out.梁→樑: 梁 is also a surname and a proper-name character
left_out.峰→峯: proper names; both forms current in Hong Kong
left_out.床→牀: 牀 reads archaic to most readers
